columnDescriptions.impressions: Total times the ad was shown to users.
columnDescriptions.interaction_event_types: List of interaction types recorded, e.g., CLICK.
columnDescriptions.interactions: Total user interactions with the ad.
columnDescriptions.ad_network_type: Network where ad served, e.g., SEARCH or SEARCH_PARTNERS.
columnDescriptions.click_type: Type of click recorded, e.g., URL_CLICKS, CALLS, SITELINKS.
columnDescriptions.date: Calendar date of the performance data.
columnDescriptions.device: Device category of the user, e.g., MOBILE, DESKTOP, TABLET.
columnDescriptions.Hierarchy_L1: Top-level organizational entity, e.g., health system name.
columnDescriptions.Hierarchy_L2: Second organizational level, typically geographic region.
columnDescriptions.Hierarchy_L3: Third organizational level, typically health network brand.
columnDescriptions.Hierarchy_L4: Fourth level representing a service line or department.
columnDescriptions.Hierarchy_L5: Fifth level representing a specific facility or program.
columnDescriptions.Hierarchy_L6: Sixth level representing a sub-specialty or service within a facility.
